rules.content:
title: BPH IP Block Migration Post-Sanctions
status: experimental
description: Detect IP address blocks previously associated with sanctioned or seized BPH providers appearing under new BGP announcements from different ASNs. Track continuity of malicious hosting through IP block
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: bgp_monitoring
    service: ip_allocation
detection:
    selection:
        previously_sanctioned_ip_range: true
        new_bgp_announcement: true
        different_asn: true
        timeframe|lte: "90d"
    condition: selection
level: high
rules.title: DL-0110: BPH IP Block Migration Post-Sanctions (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale
status: experimental
description: Detect patterns consistent with legitimate cloud provider IP blocks being resold for BPH: unusual CNAME density (100+ domains per IP), diverse domain registrants sharing the same cloud IP range, and h
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: cname_analysis
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        cloud_provider_ip: true
        cname_density|gt: 100
        diverse_registrants: true
        abuse_ratio|gt: "threshold"
    condition: selection
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0111: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks
status: experimental
description: Detect anomalous CNAME record density where hundreds or thousands of apparently unrelated domains share CNAME chains terminating at a small number of infrastructure endpoints. Indicates centrally mana
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: cname_analysis
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection:
        cname_chain_endpoint_count|gt: "threshold"
        unique_domain_count|gt: 500
        cname_chain_depth|gte: 2
    condition: selection
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0112: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks (Sigma)
